text: {"frames":["Misty Ford's Tower has a floor where a loose thread has tangled every stair into a little knot. You climb slowly, careful not to pull, and find that {c} silver keys hang from a rail, still jingling softly. The knots can only be loosened if the keys are shared out evenly between two doors. How many keys will open each door?","On the floor above, a chest stands open and its lid creaks like an old wooden gate. The threads inside have slipped their spools and wound themselves round a lantern. A keeper of the Tower has left a note saying that {c} glass beads must be split into two equal heaps before the bridge can be mended. How many beads go into each heap?","A thread bridge sways between two landings, and the little creature at your side looks down nervously at the gap. Someone has tied {c} red spools along the rail, but the knots will only come undone if they are shared out equally to both ends of the bridge. How many spools will be tied at each end?","The staircase on this floor has tangled itself into a spiral, and the steps hum softly when touched. Along the lowest step lie {c} lanterns, and the wick of each has been knotted shut. To light the way up, half of them must be lit first. How many lanterns must you light?","Morning light comes through a window where threads hang like curtains, and a door at the far end is stuck fast. Behind it, {c} tiny bells are wrapped in a bundle of wool, and each bell must be freed by sharing the bundle into two equal parts. How many bells will be in each part?"]}
